contract_mutations.name: model_failure_reason
contract_mutations.reason: The objective required empty model output to remain distinct from timeout, runtime, cancellation, and persistence failures; the original taxonomy had no truthful code for that observed state.

contract_mutations.name: deterministic_generated_at
contract_mutations.reason: The source run start timestamp makes repeated boundary exports byte-stable instead of inventing fresh measurement time.

contract_mutations.name: conflicting_judge_methods
contract_mutations.reason: Conflicting method-specific winners are classified as judge-method mismatch rather than falsely described as overlapping intervals.

contract_mutations.name: no_scored_evidence
contract_mutations.reason: Completed result-backed outputs without eligible same-method scores require a distinct abstention boundary instead of being mislabeled as absent measurement.

contract_mutations.name: exact_rescore_clearance
contract_mutations.reason: Rescoring without a new run is permitted only when one capability has at least three result-backed completed measured trials for each of at least two exact candidates.

contract_mutations.name: immutable_distinct_score_evidence
contract_mutations.reason: PR review proved that repeated score revisions, mutable prompt categories, and display-name collisions could weaken the deterministic boundary. The consumer now uses the latest score per distinct result, immutable manifest categories, and model IDs for directional conflicts.
